selected_evidence.requirement: Only HR administrator can administer employeeNumber
selected_evidence.summary: Administrator reads, changes, and restores employeeNumber; final value is HR-4815.

selected_evidence.requirement: Anonymous users see no employee records
selected_evidence.summary: Anonymous employee result count is zero before and after restarts.
Credentials were generated on-node and retained as root-owned mode-0600 files for reader and administrator demonstrations.
Both nodes remain on RHEL 9.8 with kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8.x86_64.
